notes.title: Update 1.21 is now live.
notes.content:
Hello! This is an extremely minor update to In The Foundations.

Patch 1.21:

- makes sure your grandpa actually knew your dad's name
- fixes typo in Ending 7

Thanks everyone for your continuing support!

notes.title: Thank you so much for playing In The Foundations!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45531735/51b961a07236245eab27f52466cef4d9acf8866f.png[/img]


Thank you to everyone who was able to check out In The Foundations.

I started this game for a combination of game jams in October 2024 but loves the idea so much I decided to keep working on it instead of releasing it only 70% done.

Getting feedback has been really nice, whether it be reviews, emails, or even just seeing the amount of people getting specific achievements.

- beepsoft industries
